Name: Bad Penny
Author: wetfart
Description:
This mod is a Content Pack which comprehensively replaces Penny with her evil doppelganger (over 1,000 lines of custom dialogue, sprite and portrait).

For best results, do not use the main or optional dialogue-only file with other mods that affect dialogue for Penny, Pam, Vincent, Jas, Jodi, Kent, Marnie, or Sam. It won't break your game if you do, but you might notice inconsistencies in their attitudes about Penny. If you're using other dialogue mods for the characters listed, you may be best suited to using the sprite and portrait pack only.
